question: Can the existing full-eye measured-grid sensory interface be made numerically convergent under the exact same biological and scene assumptions?
measured_facts: 857 L / 852 R measured facet directions and lens origins
EXP-010 local translation errors 4.952% / 6.063% under the unchanged 5% criterion
literature_constraints: Retain the frozen EXP-008 truncated spherical Gaussian acceptance function and measured local grid; no new physiology
assumptions: Exact frozen EXP-008 finite painted wall, spherical opaque blocker, radiance and prescribed poses
Frozen EXP-009 local readout and type adapter; frozen EXP-005/004 downstream operators
Instantaneous achromatic acceptance integral remains a provisional photoreceptor proxy
unknowns: Individual measured-eye to MaleCNS registration (not investigated here)
Absolute optical or photoreceptor biological calibration
Accuracy beyond the finest finite reference
optical_method: Integrate the identical normalized exp(-theta^2/(2 sigma^2)) sin(theta) integral on 0..3sigma. Analytically split radial intervals at spherical-blocker tangencies and integrate only the visible azimuthal arc; add blocked constant radiance by its angular measure. Sine-squared radial mapping resolves endpoint square-root behavior. No scene smoothing or acceptance change.

ordered_levels.name: coarse
ordered_levels.role: combined refinement baseline; reference optics are subsampled exactly onto this temporal grid

ordered_levels.name: production
ordered_levels.role: frozen candidate optical level and shared optical-comparison time grid

ordered_levels.name: reference
ordered_levels.role: finest predeclared finite optical/temporal reference; nested subsamples provide 1.0/0.5 ms temporal comparisons

reference: Finest predeclared finite calculation, not ground truth: 32 radial / 64 azimuthal nodes per split interval/arc, 0.25ms light. No further candidate is added after output inspection.

smooth_wall_acceleration.method: Unoccluded-wall integral only: exact Z-rotation harmonic; degree-16 adaptive Chebyshev translation table on 0..2mm or -2..0mm. Evaluate blocker arcs directly at every pose; never interpolate visibility.
smooth_wall_acceleration.validation: Independent off-node checks during construction, plus direct all-facet unoccluded rays at 41 uniformly spaced physical poses per condition. This is a numerical approximation, not a changed scene or sensory acceptance. No downstream output selects it.

execution_path_resolution.original_predeclared_contract: The degree-16 adaptive Chebyshev translation accelerator with absolute tolerance 1e-10 and maximum subdivision depth 12 remains the original frozen contract and is retained as a negative preflight record.
execution_path_resolution.preflight_resolution: The accelerator failed before any canonical +X/-X translation output was evaluated. Bounded diagnosis found a genuine accelerator limitation, not an implementation or verification error; the pole-adjacent explanation remains an inference about the finite frozen low-order evaluator.
execution_path_resolution.direct_benchmark: The full-eye direct AcceptanceIntegral path was benchmarked before canonical translation outputs were examined and was deterministic on replay.
execution_path_resolution.canonical_translation_path: For translation conditions only, call AcceptanceIntegral.sample with the frozen optical order and smooth_light omitted. This evaluates the identical frozen normalized optical integral while removing the failed approximation. Preserve the exact Z-rotation harmonic path for nontranslation conditions.
execution_path_resolution.unchanged_contracts: No optical order, temporal level, scene, acceptance function, biology, threshold, downstream parameter, or frozen predecessor changes.

quadrature_normalization: Use one finite full-cone normalization per numerical order, exactly once for the complete truncated spherical-Gaussian cone. Clear, mixed, and fully blocked visibility pieces are subdivisions of that same integral; never renormalize a visibility piece. Report finite full-cone mass error against a high-order direct reference separately from numerator and final normalized-light errors.
temporal_contract: There is one sensor stream per optical level: coarse 1.0 ms, production 0.5 ms, reference 0.25 ms. The 1.0/0.5/0.25 ms hierarchy is obtained by exact nested subsampling of the reference physical samples; no diagonal or second temporal stream exists.

comparison.relative_error: max absolute difference / max(max absolute state in either array, 1e-12), with separate stage normalizers
comparison.optical: coarse vs production and production vs reference at shared 0.5ms physical times and identical 0.25ms neural hold
comparison.temporal: reference optics at 1, 0.5 and 0.25ms, obtained by exact nested subsampling; identical 0.25ms neural grid
comparison.combined: coarse optics at 1ms vs production at 0.5ms vs reference at 0.25ms
comparison.neural: identical production sensory samples at 0.25ms and 0.125ms neural update; compare coincident outputs
comparison.visibility: Analytic possible/mixed support-cone regions for localization only; never supplied to the local neural transform
comparison.absolute_metrics: All stage maxima, global relative errors, per-entity peak percentiles, squared error energy and concentration; inspect facets 400 and 711 separately

acceptance.trend: Final light, raw-correlator, signed-stencil and local-emission max absolute discrepancies must not exceed the preceding discrepancy by more than 1e-12, separately for optical, temporal and combined refinements in every condition
acceptance.candidate_gate: Production/reference combined, separated final optical/temporal, and neural-half-step local stages and pooled channels must all meet 5%; final coincident optical light difference must meet 1e-4; trends, finite/bounded states and controls must pass. Freeze only this candidate before any downstream evaluation.
acceptance.determinism: Exact arrays and recorded trace digests
acceptance.analytic_preflight: Constant-radiance conservation, centered-shadow Gaussian mass, mixed visibility vs independent dense rays, away-boundary convergence, visibility transitions, shared temporal samples, observer isolation
controls: Only after local gate: local-to-downstream and central disconnection with unchanged surviving operators
Downstream contraction/decay and timestep checks if integration is evaluated
acceptance.negative_result: Failure of the bounded candidate or convergence trend is an explicit negative/partial numerical result; no downstream validation claim and no further refinement search

record_generation_gate: Frozen source integrity, analytical implementation preflight, finite deterministic diagnostics and local controls pass. Acceptance resolves explicitly to positive or negative; never overwrite an existing canonical record.
